本研究面向多维表格设计文档的自动修复：模型根据用户需求和产品规则发现问题，修改: This study investigates automated repair of multidimensional-table design documents. Models use user requirements and product rules to identify defects, revise SpecDoc or HostPlan, and check whether the final design supports actual table construction. From June to October 2026, experiments compared local repairs, model switching, history feedback, voting, format recovery, and before/after verification, yielding a four-domain Judge–Fix–Router pipeline and a separate change-verification track.

自动修复的困难有两部分。首先，Judge 必须区分业务缺口、能力限制和允许的表达: Automated repair faces two problems. Judges must distinguish business gaps, capability limits, and acceptable variations in expression without flagging valid designs. Fix must remove defects while preserving meaning. Making an administrator read-only may satisfy one permission constraint but prevent administration; replacing net cash flow with income may remove a formula defect while changing the metric.
